note:
415, the count on the day odoo.tools entered the gate. Not a target -- a ceiling that only moves down.

MEASURED THE WAY py_typecheck.yml PRESCRIBES: mypy 2.3.0 and NOTHING ELSE in the venv, --no-incremental, `-p odoo.tools`, in a tree holding only this change. Two consecutive runs, 415 both times.

  same tree, venv with the project's dependencies installed   455
  mypy alone (this number)                                    415

The 40 between them is the gap CLAUDE.md 9.3 warns about in the other direction: the venv resolves lxml, psycopg and dateutil to real stubs where CI resolves them to Any. RE-MEASURE, NEVER SUBTRACT -- the delta is version-specific and is not arithmetic you can apply to a later mypy.

ITS OWN BASELINE, NOT A LINE ADDED TO `mypy`. The mypy gate counts six packages -- orm, db, libs, http, service, modules -- as one integer. Folding a seventh in would make every future move ambiguous between the two scopes, the way c901 and c901_addons are kept apart for the same reason. One flag, one baseline.

WHY THE PACKAGE WAS WORTH ONBOARDING. odoo.tools carried annotations everywhere and was checked by nothing, so they asserted nothing: 69 of them said `: object` for what is an Environment, a FrameType, a Callable or an IO stream, which reads as typed and admits everything. Three defects found in the audit that produced this baseline were visible to a type checker and to nothing else in CI -- `parse_config` annotated `-> None` and returning a value, `expiration_value` holding bytes and then int, `translate_xml_node` taking a parameter it never read. mypy's own `unused section(s)` note had also been pointing at a stale [mypy-odoo.tools.embedded_sass_pb2] block for as long as the module has lived in odoo/libs/_vendor/, and nobody was reading the output it appeared in.

The count opened at 534 and was 415 by the time it was committed. What moved:

  534 -> 494   translate.py's frame walkers, cursors and IO streams typed
  494 -> 455   Collector.profiler stopped being Optional (see below)
  455 -> 415   the venv/mypy-alone difference, not a fix

The middle one is a design change and not an annotation: a Collector is built before the Profiler that owns it, so `profiler` was `Profiler | None` and one Optional propagated into 48 errors. It is a property now, raising once if a collector is used before a profiler has adopted it, instead of forty-eight guards that were never written.
